name: classicube
description: Build and explore a blocky 3D world.
author: UnknownShadow200 (ClassiCube), ported to SwirlOS
title: ClassiCube
tagline: A Minecraft Classic-style sandbox, ported to SwirlOS.
long:
ClassiCube is an open-source voxel sandbox in the spirit of Minecraft Classic. Place and break blocks, explore a generated world and build whatever you like. Singleplayer only for now, no sound yet.
With the GPU Drivers package and a supported Intel GPU it draws on the graphics chip (OpenGL); otherwise it uses its built-in software renderer. To force the software renderer, create the file /home/user/ClassiCube/use-cpu.
WASD to move, mouse to look, Space to jump, B for the block menu, Esc for the menu. Worlds are saved in your ClassiCube folder.
Note: uses the same memory region as DOOM, so don't run both at once. GPU mode needs SwirlOS r140 or newer.
